title: Enums
prompt:
Write three enum classes in `solution.py`:

**Requirements:**
1. `HttpStatus(IntEnum)` with members `OK = 200`, `NOT_FOUND = 404`, `ERROR = 500`.
2. `Color(Enum)` with members `RED = "red"`, `GREEN = "green"`, `BLUE = "blue"`. Add an `is_primary(self)` method returning `True` for `RED` and `BLUE`.
3. `Permission(Flag)` with members `READ = 1`, `WRITE = 2`, `EXECUTE = 4`. Permissions can be combined with `|`.

**Examples:**
```python
HttpStatus.OK == 200             # True (IntEnum)
HttpStatus.OK.value              # 200

Color.RED.is_primary()           # True
Color.GREEN.is_primary()         # False

p = Permission.READ | Permission.WRITE
Permission.READ in p             # True
Permission.EXECUTE in p          # False
```
hints: IntEnum members can be compared to integers: HttpStatus.OK == 200
Enum members are accessed by name: Color.RED
Flag members combine with |: Permission.READ | Permission.WRITE
Add methods to Enum classes like any other class
